properties.name: fileforge.provider
properties.description: Storage backend to activate. 's3' is the only implementation shipped today; any other value leaves FileForge inactive while keeping the dependency.

properties.name: fileforge.naming.strategy
properties.description: Object key layout. date-uuid: documents/2026/09/17/<uuid>.pdf. uuid: documents/<uuid>.pdf. year-uuid: the 1.x layout, documents/2026_<uuid>.pdf.

properties.name: fileforge.naming.keep-extension
properties.description: Whether the generated key keeps the original file extension.

properties.name: fileforge.naming.zone
properties.description: Time zone the date path is derived in. Pinned rather than following the system default, so keys are reproducible across hosts.

properties.name: fileforge.validation.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum allowed file size, enforced against the measured content rather than a caller's claim.

properties.name: fileforge.validation.allowed-mime-types
properties.description: Whitelist of allowed MIME types. Must not be empty.

properties.name: fileforge.validation.verify-magic-bytes
properties.description: Whether file content must match its declared content type.

properties.name: fileforge.validation.unknown-type-policy
properties.description: What to do with a whitelisted content type that has no known magic-byte signature and therefore cannot be verified. allow: accept it. reject: store only content the library can verify.

properties.name: fileforge.buffering.in-memory-threshold
properties.description: Uploads up to this size are buffered in memory to establish their real length; larger ones spill to a temporary file.

properties.name: fileforge.buffering.temp-dir
properties.description: Where to spill uploads larger than the in-memory threshold. Defaults to the JVM temporary directory.

properties.name: fileforge.web.problem-details.enabled
properties.description: Whether to publish a @RestControllerAdvice mapping FileForge exceptions to RFC 7807 ProblemDetail responses. Off by default so the library does not take over a consumer's error handling.

properties.name: fileforge.s3.bucket
properties.description: Bucket used by the consuming application. Required.

properties.name: fileforge.s3.endpoint
properties.description: S3-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://nas:7070. Omit it to talk to real AWS S3.

properties.name: fileforge.s3.access-key
properties.description: Access key. Omit it, together with the secret key, to use the AWS default credential chain (IAM roles, instance profiles, SSO, environment).

properties.name: fileforge.s3.secret-key
properties.description: Secret key. Must be set together with the access key.

properties.name: fileforge.s3.path-style-access
properties.description: Path-style addressing. True suits self-hosted gateways; set false for real AWS S3.

properties.name: fileforge.profiles
properties.description: Named upload categories keyed by profile name, each supplying a folder and optional validation overrides that inherit from fileforge.validation. Referenced as store(file, profile = "documents").

values.description: Any S3-compatible backend: AWS S3, versitygw, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, LocalStack.
